About us

Because the best moments deserve to be remembered

Reel The Moment helps you discover event photographers, wedding photographers and videographers servicing your area across Australia.

Get Photography & Videography Quotes Get Quotes
REC 00:00:24

Some moments happen once. The right photographer or videographer makes sure you can experience them again.

Reel The Moment was created to make finding the right creative professional simpler. We know how much trust you place in the people you choose for an occasion that matters, because photography and videography are personal choices. The professionals you select are responsible for capturing the memories you keep long after the event is over.

What we do

We help Australians discover event photographers, wedding photographers, videographers and visual content professionals servicing their area. Whether you are planning a wedding, birthday, engagement, family celebration or corporate event, our goal is to help you explore styles, find providers who cover your location and request quotes from people suited to your event.

Find a style that feels like you

Every photographer and videographer sees a moment differently. From candid photography and beautiful portraits to cinematic films and complete event coverage, Reel The Moment helps connect your occasion with the professionals who can capture it.

Tell us about your event and we will help you compare suitable providers.

Capture the moments worth remembering.

Ready to find your photographer or videographer?

Tell us about your event and discover the professionals ready to capture it, anywhere in Australia.
